original_ai_output.title_zh: 专家：护理人员之间的冲突与孕产妇及新生儿死亡相关
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 母婴健康专家、MamaCare by Racheal 首席执行官 Racheal Hesse Matey 警告称，产科护理人员之间未解决的冲突正在间接导致孕产妇和新生儿死亡。该说法来自单一来源报道，尚未获得其他来源证实。

key_facts.fact: 母婴健康专家警告产科护理人员之间未解决的冲突间接导致孕产妇和新生儿死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Maternal and child health expert and Chief Executive Officer of MamaCare by Racheal, Mrs Racheal Hesse Matey, has warned that unresolved conflicts among obstetric care providers are indirectly contributing to maternal and neonatal deaths.

key_facts.fact: 相关报道目前为单一来源，尚缺乏交叉验证
